amenities.name: Hot Tub
amenities.description: Commands a 20-50% price premium in many markets, especially nature or cold-weather destinations.

amenities.name: Private Pool
amenities.description: Major driver of high nightly rates in warm climates or summer destinations.

amenities.name: EV Charger
amenities.description: Strong differentiator for affluent travelers with electric vehicles.

amenities.name: Fire Pits / Outdoor Living Space
amenities.description: Extends usable space and boosts perceived value.

amenities.name: Air Conditioning & Heating
amenities.description: Essential for competitive rates, especially central AC in warm climates.

amenities.name: Fast, Reliable Wi-Fi
amenities.description: Crucial for almost all travelers; exact high speeds convert bookings.

amenities.name: Full Kitchen & Essentials
amenities.description: Allows guests to save on dining, making them willing to spend more on accommodation.

amenities.name: In-Unit Washer & Dryer
amenities.description: Non-negotiable filter for guests staying longer than a few days.

amenities.name: King-Size Bed & Premium Bedding
amenities.description: High ROI investment; appeals to couples and improves sleep ratings.

amenities.name: Dedicated Workspace
amenities.description: Essential for digital nomads and business travelers booking longer stays.

amenities.name: Pet-Friendly
amenities.description: Opens listing to massive segment; allows for pet fees or higher rates.

amenities.name: Family/Kid Essentials
amenities.description: Items like Pack 'n Play and high chair drive conversions for family bookings.

amenities.name: Smart Locks & Self Check-in
amenities.description: Reduces friction and appeals to guests who prefer privacy or arrive late.
